dataList.content:
You're late, Clock.
晚了，时钟。
dataList.place:
An Alleyway of T Corp.
T公司小巷

dataList.content:
The two Sinners had a head start, but it didn't take very long before we caught up to them and saw them quietly kneeling behind cover.
和先行出发的两名罪人会合时，他们已经找到了潜伏的地方，弓起身子并屏住了呼吸。

We'll go ahead and draw their attention! We should be able to corner them in this direction.
我们先走一步去吸引其注意力！应该能把那家伙逼到这边来。

<Since Ryōshū and Hong Lu are out there to draw the culprit here... we just have to do our part and capture them.>
<良秀和鸿璐去了那边……只要我们巧妙地突袭成功就能完成任务了。>

Yeah...
是啊……

<What's wrong, Rodya?>
<罗佳，你怎么了？>

Just... every time I think about Sonya...
我一想到索尼亚……

... I remember all the things that I couldn't do. That's all.
就回想起了那些自己没能做到的事情。仅此而已。

<Rodya...>
<罗佳……>

Argh, nope! Not gonna let this drag me down. I just gotta do what I can at this moment, right? Wouldn't it be so nice if the culprit showed up right now so I can get my hands on 'em and get this over with?
啊~哎呀，没什么啦！现在开始做也不晚啦。我只要在这里帅气地逮住犯人就好啦。

Ugh, all this waiting around is getting so tedious. Hopefully I'll look real badass when I arrest 'em.
啊，一直等着好无聊啊~但我必须得潇洒地抓住犯人。

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
You certainly recover quick. Now that’s a good attitude to have.
振作得挺快啊。心态不错嘛。

Well, you know~ Ain’t that how emotions are supposed to be? Constantly changing with time, y’know?
情感不就是这样吗~时时刻刻都会改变呢。

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
Is it now? I don't quite agree. Emotions don't change with time.
是吗？我不那么想哦。情感可不是随着时间在改变。

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
I'd say that the changing emotions are what drive the flow of time.
正因为情感在变化，所以时间才会流逝。

Hmm~ That's some complicated stuff.
哼~你说得太难懂啦。

I just can't wait to hear all the praises they'll sing of me once I snag this Yurodivy rascal, that's all~
现在我只想……在我“啪”的一声逮住圣愚的犯人后，被表扬一番呢~

Y'know, I wanna be... an ace detective.
我想……成为名侦探。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Then you shall have your chance.
那你的机会来了。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
A chance for you to be the center of attention. A subject of praise.
那个能集大家的赞扬于一身的机会。

That long coat... that hat...
长风衣……帽子……

You're...
你是……

Rodya~ Dante~ The culprit ran that way!
罗佳小姐~但丁经理~那人往你们那边跑了！

You're... The Time Ripper.
时间杀人魔啊……

Correct.
没错。

<This isn't good... It'll take a while for Hong Lu and Ryōshū to get here...!>
<偏偏是在良秀和鸿璐在远处的时候来了……>

But before we get down to business, allow me to make a few corrections.
不过，要修正的地方……有两处。

One. I am no longer bound to an organization like the Yurodiviye.
其一。我……已不再被圣愚这样的团体所束缚。

In fact, I found their hypocrisy detestable. Did you know that even the Yurodiviye do not use their hours equally amongst one another? That is why I have chosen action.
甚至在他们之间，时间也没有被公平地使用，这让我很不满意。而那就是我行动的原因。

Two. I am not 'killing time'. You will not compare my crusade to something so hollow.
其二。我并不只是在进行谋杀时间这种毫无意义的行为。

I merely reap the dying hours... to share it among those who need it most.
我取出了濒死的时间……并用在了十分需要它的人们身上。

You may call me the Time Saint instead.
你们倒不如喊我时间圣者。

What... the hell are you talking about? Shut up and—
你在……说什么东西？别说胡话了……

All this is flying over your head, isn't it? You poor little thing, starved for even a morsel of praise...
你似乎完全没有理解我的意图呢，真是个渴求赞扬的可怜鬼。

This is both a correction of your ignorance, and our final warning.
这是对你们的无知而进行的修正，同时也是我们最后的警告。

If you wish to capture me... no, us... then you must be prepared to pay the price in time.
我警告你们，如果想要抓到我……不，我们，就要付出相应的时间作为代价。

Was that an attempt at a threat? Ha, do you seriously think you can scare me like that?
这是威胁吗？哈，你觉得这样我们就会害怕吗？

Sure, you're the big, scary 'Time Ripper', but I've got ya all figured out. I know your patterns. There's something staying your hand, isn't there? Whether it's your creed, some kind of a design flaw in your tech... you can't touch my time.
不管是多么疯狂的杀人魔……你至今为止的行动也是遵循着一定模式的。不管那是你的信念，还是你武器的弱点，你都没法杀死我的时间。

How'd ya like this ace detective's deductions, huh? Fuhu.
这就是名侦探的敏锐推理！呼呼。

Half right. But you have given me two more corrections to make.
对了一半。但是要修正的地方又多了两处。

One. I am not the one killing time. It's you, and everyone like you who's killing time.
其一。杀死时间的人不是我，而是你们。

Two. Indeed, we cannot rip time away from just anyone, no. But... I can take yours.
然后是其二。我们的确不能从每个人的身上都夺走时间……但是可以夺走你的时间。

Because you, at this very moment...
因为你，现在……

... are mired in tedium.
感到特别无聊。

… What?
……欸？

Just biding the time, aren't you? Waiting for something to happen. Killing time.
你只是在等待时间不是吗。一边消磨时间，一边杀死它。

We are merely taking back the time that you would have killed anyway.
我们便拿走那些濒死的时间。

Hah, ha... haha...
哈……哈哈……

Swing that axe and you might carve a small chunk of our flesh. But...
如果你挥下那柄斧子……也许能切下我们的一小块肉。但是……

... We... will rip a chunk out of your existence.
我们也可以……切下你的人生。

You will stir awake when the clock strikes four, in fifty-years' time; having done nothing, having lived through nothing, all in the blink of an eye.
你会在半个世纪后，时钟报出下午四点时，像是什么也没有发生似的醒过来吧。

That's when it shall dawn on you, that despair. It'll all come rushing in like a flood; that disparity, the unfamiliarity... of all the time you killed.
然后，那因杀死时间而感到的后悔将蜂拥而至，你将毫无保留地感受着那份差异感……渐渐绝望。

... Every pain a reminder of every single second you've killed, thinking about how tedious it all is.
你会……回想起那无聊的每分每秒。

You look scared. I—we—like that look in your eyes.
你好像害怕了。那是我，也是我们喜欢的眼神。

Rodya stood there, completely frozen. No one could stop the Time Ripper as he walked away from us. Not me, not Rodya.
现场只剩下僵住的罗佳和无能为力的我，没人能阻止想要离开的时间杀人魔。

The culprit. Where are they?
那家伙，哪去了？

I... I thought I could take them on. But... when I came face-to-face with the Ripper, I...
我……还以为能亲手抓住他……但当我面对他时……

Tsk, how could you give them the slip?
啧，你们把他放跑了？

<They threatened her. That they were going to rip away her time...>
<他威胁了罗佳。说要夺走她的时间……>

Oh no...
这也太……

And the Ripper knew. They knew how... how I felt so...
而且……他早就知道。我感到特别……

... Never mind.
……没事。

It seemed to me that Rodya decided to not say it out loud, but I knew that the word she wanted to say was 'tedious'.
……罗佳似乎决定不说出“无聊”这个词，把它咽了回去。

Pathetic.
真可悲。

Unlike you, Ryōshū, my time… is important.
良秀……不像你，我的时间……很重要。

I’m not here just to make those stupid, pointless observations about the case. I didn’t volunteer out of some weird obligation either, okay? I volunteered because I genuinely wanted to solve the case. I’m not like you. Either of you.
我不是来对这起事件评头论足的，也不是被人逼着来这里的，而是真的想解决这起事件才自愿前来的。我和你们都不一样。

I briefly grew concerned that Ryōshū might swing her scabbard at Rodya, but... I don't think she was listening anyway.
我还担心良秀会因为这些话而对罗佳挥起刀鞘，但她似乎没有在听罗佳的话……

… How banal.
……乏味。

Instead, she stared up at the Clock Tower in silence as her cigarette slowly burned its way to her lips.
她只是点起了烟，目不转睛地望着钟楼。

I guess that's a... relief...
可以说还好没事吧……

Rodya, I...
罗佳小姐……

Sorry. I think I'm just getting tired of wearing a silly smile.
抱歉，我大概已经厌倦了装出一副傻笑的样子了……
